_comment: The model catalogue both apps read. Bundled in each app, and re-fetched from catalogue_url on every update check so a newly published model shows up without an app release. A model with status 'planned' is listed as coming soon and cannot be downloaded. Protocol: shared/update-protocol.md. desktop/tests/test_shared.py fails if either app's bundled copy drifts from this file.

models.name: Parakeet (stock)

models.summary: Fine-tuned on English with Hebrew words in it (teudat zehut, arnona, makolet). One speaker's voice.
